Rebuild Alabama Act Annual Grant Program

What is the Rebuild Alabama Act Annual Grant Program?
The RAA Annual Grant Program is an ALDOT administered transportation infrastructure grant program for projects of local interest created in the Rebuild Alabama Act of 2019.

Projects may be submitted for improvements to any classified road or bridge open to public traffic.
